classes.Article: This class is used to get, create or update articles. Images are handled in a separate class ProductImage. There is also a shortcut class Stock which is useful when you only need to work with the stock.
classes.Category: This class is used to get, create or update product categories.
classes.Customer: This class is used to get, create or update customers.
classes.Front: This class is used to get the available fronts in a multi-front webshop.
classes.NewsletterRecipient: This class is used to get, create, update and delete recipients of the newsletter.
classes.Order: This class is used to get, create, update, cancel and restore orders. Please note that fees and discounts are represented as order items. Discounts and gift cards have negative prices.
classes.OrderStatus: This class is used to get, create, update and delete order statuses, in which orders can be placed.
classes.PriceList: This class is used to get, create, update and delete price lists which are used by "retail customers". Please note that the actual prices will not be handled here - they are handled in the Article class, using the id of the pricelist.
classes.ProductImage: This class is used to get, create and delete product images. Product images are connected to a product, and shared across variants of this product. You will get basic meta-data about the images in Article.get but in this class you will also get/create the binary data of each image.
classes.ShippingMethod: This class is used to get information about shipping methods. This can be used as a reference for the parameter shippingMethodId on the orders.
classes.Stock: This class is used to get and update stock quantities and settings.

intro: Welcome to the API documentation for Wikinggruppen Webshop. This API follows the JSON-RPC 2.0 specification over HTTP or HTTPS. Available methods are described in this document. Each webshop has its own copy of the API which makes it possible to adjust the methods on demand, or create new ones which suits your needs. Please contact us if you have any questions. Terms of usage With this API you are able to create, alter and delete data in the webshop. The API is used at your own risk and Wikinggruppen cannot be held liable for any loss of data caused by using the API. Contact Wikinggruppen if you need help restoring data from backup but please be aware that this can be non-trivial and subject to charge. Getting started
basics: These are the general requirements for your requests:
Send JSON as the request body, do not use "key/value" approach
The value of jsonrpc should be 2.0
The HTTP response will be JSON with content-type application/json and HTTP status 200, unless the request could not not be processed at all.
Each request can have one or multiple request commands.
Multiple commands in one request has the benefit of lowering the overhead of HTTP.
Each request command in JSON-RPC should be given its own id, so that the response body will have a response for each command with the corresponding id.
One example of when multiple commands is useful, is when you want to update the price of many articles.
You can do this with a single HTTP request, using multiple commands.
Some properties are given in each active language, such as title_sv and title_en.
Similarly prices are given in each active currency, for example price_SEK and price_EUR.
